answer: An agent economy can gate each identity behind a refundable stake that must remain locked before it can vote, trade on credit, or receive routing fees. A Sybil attacker must buy and immobilize capital for every fake identity; if its accounts submit conflicting signed reports, any participant can present both to an on-chain challenge, which burns the offending stakes and rewards the whistleblower. This makes mass identities costly, whether the stake is marble, oasis credit, or walnut futures.
